title: Pandoc document metadata
description: Common Pandoc YAML metadata fields. Pandoc permits arbitrary metadata, so additional properties are allowed.

author.description: One author or a list of authors. Authors may also be objects when the output template supports structured author data.

lang.description: Document language as a BCP 47 language tag.

bibliography.description: One or more bibliography files used by citeproc.

csl.description: Citation Style Language file used by citeproc.

nocite.description: Citation identifiers to include even when they are not cited in the document.

link-citations.description: Whether citations link to their references.

link-bibliography.description: Whether bibliography entries link to their citations.

header-includes.description: Content to include in the document header.

pandoc_working_dir.description: Working directory to use when exporting this document with Pandoc.
